## Drive smarter personalized journeys 
### Machine Learning predictive triggers
Our data lakehouse allows us to build actionable predictive trigger models.
### Actionable data-driven cross-selling
Enriched member data insights create highly targeted opportunities to build wallet share with relevant next best cross-selling.
### AI-driven customer insights and smart queries
A private GPT trained to guide financial leaders to rich customer insights and smarter marketing actions.
### Lifestyle-driven personas for personalized journeys
Rich 3rd party psychographic, financial and demographic insights, and 1st party behavioral and transactional data drive growth personas that fuel personalization.
### Business intelligence and AI-dashboards
Data insights are visualized in PowerBI dashboards, with custom filtering, and our private GPT model generating AI dashboards.
### Automate sales tracking, conversions and campaign ROI
Automated two-way data flow ensures daily and YTD performance dashboards of account sales, conversions and campaign ROI.
![A woman in her 30's with a text overlaying showing the process of machine learning triggers when a credit union member makes a home improvement purchase.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6711903cd9703fa3088ff14e/6760d9d4616e8c08ba236779_ML%20Triggers%20Graphic.avif)

With full control of member data, marketers can leverage AI-driven queries and lifestyle segments to build targeted lists without IT support.
